info.title: Search API
info.description:
The Scaleway Search API enables you to locate products and resources across an organization.

**Search by**:

- Product name or resource type
- Resource ID
- Resource name

**Returned metadata**:

- Resource location
- Associated project (name and ID)
- Creation and last modified date

## Concepts

Refer to the [Organizations and Projects - Glossary](https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/organizations-and-projects/concepts/glossary/), or [Use the Resource Explorer](https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/organizations-and-projects/project/use-resource-explorer/) to find definitions and information on all Search API related terminology.

## Quickstart

Note that the Search is also integrated in the [Scaleway CLI](https://www.scaleway.com/en/developers/cli). Refer to [scw search](https://www.scaleway.com/en/developers/cli/search) in CLI documentation for more details.

<Message type="requirement">
- You have a [Scaleway account](https://console.scaleway.com/)
- You have created an [API key](https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/iam/how-to/create-api-keys/) and that the API key has sufficient [IAM permissions](https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/iam/reference-content/permission-sets/) to perform the actions described on this page
- You have [installed `curl`](https://curl.se/download.html)
</Message>

1. Configure your environment variables:

   <Message type="note">
   This is an optional step that seeks to simplify your usage of the Search API.
   </Message>

    ```bash
    export SCW_SECRET_KEY="<YOUR_API_SECRET_KEY>"
    export SCW_ORGANIZATION_ID="<YOUR_ORGANIZATION_ID>"
    ```

2. Run the following command to perform a basic search query and get the list of the resources attached to your organization:

    ```bash
    curl -X GET \
        -H "X-Auth-Token: $SCW_SECRET_KEY" \
        "https://api.scaleway.com/search/v1alpha1/resources?organization_id=$SCW_ORGANIZATION_ID"
    ```

   Example response:

    ```json
    {
    "resources": [
        {
        "id": "0dac255c-83e7-483a-895c-73a6e1bdaca4",
        "name": "my-cpu-instance-example",
        "organization_id": "13280ed3-afff-4abc-9a8c-eb972589c821",
        "project_id": "13270ed5-afff-4abc-8a7c-eb972389c821",
        "type": "sbs_volume",
        "zone": "fr-par-1",
        "created_at": "2026-10-09T11:54:21.593179Z",
        "updated_at": "2026-10-09T11:54:22.438089Z"
        }
    ],
    "next_page_token": ""
    }
    ```

## Technical information

### Availability Zones / Regions

Scaleway Search API is a global service. It can search for Scaleway products and resources on whatever locality (zone, region or global as well) they are in.

## Technical limitations

Refer to the [Resource explorer - Supported resource types](https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/organizations-and-projects/project/use-resource-explorer/#supported-resource-types) documentation for the complete list of resources supported by the Search API.

## Going further

For more help using Scaleway Search API, check out the following resources:

- The [`search` CLI documentation](https://www.scaleway.com/en/developers/cli/search#documentation-for-scw-search)
- Scaleway [main documentation](https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/)
- The [Slack Community](https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/tutorials/scaleway-slack-community/)
- The Scaleway [support ticketing system](https://www.scaleway.com/en/docs/account/how-to/open-a-support-ticket/).

ip.description: IP address of the Baremetal server.

type.description: Type of data handled by the OBS datasource.

destination_type.description: Destination type of the OBS exporter.

project_id.description: ID of the Project the resource belongs to. (UUID format)

organization_id.description: ID of the Organization the resource belongs to. (UUID format)

global.description:
Locality the resource is in if this is a global resource.
Precisely one of global, zone, region can be set.

zone.description:
Locality the resource is in if this is a zonal resource.
Precisely one of global, zone, region can be set.

region.description:
Locality the resource is in if this is a regional resource.
Precisely one of global, zone, region can be set.

vpc_private_network_info.description:
Additional information for a VPC Private Network.
Precisely one of vpc_private_network_info, serverless_functions_function_info, serverless_containers_container_info, serverless_sqldb_backup_info, baremetal_server_info, obs_datasource_info, obs_exporter_info can be set.

serverless_functions_function_info.description:

Precisely one of vpc_private_network_info, serverless_functions_function_info, serverless_containers_container_info, serverless_sqldb_backup_info, baremetal_server_info, obs_datasource_info, obs_exporter_info can be set.

values.created_at_asc: Sort by creation date in ascending order
values.created_at_desc: Sort by creation date in descending order
values.modified_at_asc: Sort by modification date in ascending order
values.modified_at_desc: Sort by modification date in descending order
values.name_asc: Sort by resource name in alphabetical order
values.name_desc: Sort by resource name in reverse alphabetical order
values.type_asc: Sort by resource type in alphabetical order
values.type_desc: Sort by resource type in reverse alphabetical order

next_page_token.description:
Opaque token to retrieve the next page of results.
If this string is empty, it means there are no more pages available.

namespace_id.description: ID of the Namespace the Serverless Container belongs to.
ID of the Namespace the Serverless Function belongs to.

database_id.description: ID of the Serverless SQL Database the backup belongs to.

vpc_id.description: ID of the VPC the Private Network belongs to.

parameters.name: organization_id
parameters.description: ID of the Organization to search in.

parameters.name: project_ids
parameters.description: List of Project IDs to filter the resources by.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: List of resource types to filter the resources by.

parameters.name: localities
parameters.description: List of scopes (zones, regions, or global) to filter the resources by.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Filter resources created after this timestamp. (RFC 3339 format)

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Filter resources created before this timestamp. (RFC 3339 format)

parameters.name: modified_after
parameters.description: Filter resources modified after this timestamp. (RFC 3339 format)

parameters.name: modified_before
parameters.description: Filter resources modified before this timestamp. (RFC 3339 format)

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description:
Opaque token used to retrieve the next page of results (cursor-based pagination).
Leave empty or omit to fetch the first page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of resources to retrieve per page.
